items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE (CVE-2026-103849)
items.summary: A CVSS 10.0 vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution via a template engine injection. Adobe fixed it in APSB26-153, but new installations may remain vulnerable without a manual patch.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical bug allows unauthenticated remote code execution and customer account takeover, with mass attacks observed in October 2026. While patched in September 2025, active exploitation continues, and the unrestricted file upload issue was not fully addressed.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including six exploitable without authentication, some leading to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (CVE-2026-75650) under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability discovered by Sansec that allows unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, with attacks starting on September 4th, 2026. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7th for this CVSS 10.0 flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability addressed in APSB26-92 that could lead to privilege escalation. This vulnerability is exploitable without authentication.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses CVE-2026-48356, a critical file upload flaw. Adobe rates this flaw as Critical, and it has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
items.summary: A critical file upload vulnerability (PolyShell) that could result in arbitrary code execution. This flaw requires user interaction and has been added to the CISA KEV catalog due to observed exploitation.
